name: Horizontal Loop
description: The Horizontal Loop, often called the Skywire Loop, is a full‑wave wire loop mounted horizontally. It provides excellent multiband performance, low noise reception, and strong NVIS capability on lower HF bands.
modelingNotes: Loop perimeter determines the fundamental resonant frequency.
Height above ground strongly affects NVIS vs DX performance.
Shape (square, triangle, irregular) has minimal effect on resonance.
Corner feedpoint provides a convenient impedance for ladder-line.
Ladder-line feed enables efficient multiband operation.
Full-wave loops exhibit low noise compared to dipoles.
